Court No. - 21

Case :- Writ - C No. - 10500 of 2023
Petitioner :- Govind Jee Ojha

Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- S.B.Singh,Sanjay Kumar Rai

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C,Dhananjay Awasthi,S.C. Dwivedi,Vinay Dubey
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Donadi Ramesh,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus commanding respondent nos.
2 and 3 to consider and decide the claim of the petitioner for payment of compensation in respect of plot nos. 27 and 710, situated in Mauja Daya Chhapra, Pargana and District Ballia, recorded in the name of the petitioner's maternal grandfather Ghanshyam Dubey.
The petitioner claims to be the sole successor on basis of a Will executed in his favour by Smt. Shobha Devi, his mother.
The petitioner apprehends that the respondent-Authority would take possession of the aforesaid land without formal acquisition and payment of compensation.

sentences.text: 1 2. SDM, Bairiya has furnished instructions to the State counsel, according to which, plot no. 27 is in process of acquisition under the provisions of the National Highways Act, 1956 as it is required for NH31.
The notification under Section 3-A of the Act was published on 25.4.2023.
3. Sri M.C. Chaturvedi, learned counsel appearing on behalf of respondent no. 6 states that the said plot would be acquired and compensation would be paid as per provisions of the Act.
4. In respect of plot no. 710, he submits that it does not fall in the alignment of the road and therefore it would not be acquired.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner admits that in view of the stand taken by the respondents, no grievance survives.
6. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of in terms of the stand taken by respondent no. 6 before this Court.
7. It shall be ensured that compensation for the acquired land is paid to the person entitled in accordance with law.
In respect of plot no. 710, the respondents shall not dispossess the petitioner if he is in possession thereof, except in accordance with law.

(Donadi Ramesh, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 19.9.2023 Jaideep/-
